collection.description: A master scientist announces a rare blossom cures every fever.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A master scientist announces a rare blossom cures every fever.

choices.label: Ask an apprentice to repeat the tests.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Several villagers recover, encouraging further study.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some become sicker, and the scientist withdraws the claim.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The apprentice finds the remedy only helps some patients.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The apprentice's small sample gives misleading results.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Most patients improve without the blossom.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A severe case worsens despite careful treatment.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The village learns to distinguish hope from proof.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The cautious report frustrates families seeking certainty.
